```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"In a free society, the primary role of government is to protect the God-given, inalienable rights of its citizens.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Constitutional rights are not negotiable for any American.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"All legislation, regulation, and official actions must conform to the Constitution's original meaning as understood at the time the language was adopted.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The most urgent task of the Party is to restore the American people's faith in their government by electing a president who will enforce duly enacted laws.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Party needs a Republican president who will honor constitutional limits on executive authority.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Party needs a Republican president who will return credibility to the Oval Office.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A Republican president will end abuses of power by departments and agencies, like the IRS and the EPA, and by the White House itself.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Safeguarding liberties requires a president who will respect the Constitution's separation of powers, including the authority of Congress to write legislation and define agency authority.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Americans deserve a president who will speak for the nation's history and values, not apologize for them to enemies.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
